lines.beaver: 이 커피 원두, 너무 비싸네요. 좀 깎아 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: These coffee beans are too expensive. Please give me a discount.
lines.beaver_roman: i keopi wondu, neomu bissaneyo. jom kkakka juseyo.
lines.learner: 수입 원두라 단가가 높아요. 그만한 값어치는 해요.
lines.en: They're imported beans, so the unit price is high. But they're worth it.
lines.roman: suip wondura dankkaga nopayo. geumanhan gabeochineun haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그래도 고가라서 망설여져요. 왜 그렇게 비싸요?
lines.beaver_en: Still, it's pricey, so I'm hesitant. Why so expensive?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraedo gokkaraseo mangseoryeojyeoyo. wae geureoke bissayo?
lines.learner: 원가 자체가 비싸서 싸게 드리기 어려워요.
lines.en: The cost price itself is high, so it's hard to sell it cheaply.
lines.roman: wonkka jachega bissaseo ssage deurigi eoryeowoyo.

lines.beaver: 맛이 어떤지 모르잖아요. 먹어 볼 수 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: I don't know how it tastes. Can I try some?
lines.beaver_roman: masi eotteonji moreujanayo. meogeo bol su isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 여기 시음용이 있어요. 한번 드셔 보세요.
lines.en: Yes, there's a tasting sample here. Please try it.
lines.roman: ne, yeogi sieumnyongi isseoyo. hanbeon deusyeo boseyo.

lines.beaver: 음, 향이 좋네요. 그런데 맛은 다 비슷하지 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: Hmm, it smells nice. But don't they all taste similar?
lines.beaver_roman: eum, hyangi jonneyo. geureonde maseun da biseutaji anayo?
lines.learner: 맛은 내리기 나름입니다. 잘 내리면 정말 달라요.
lines.en: The taste depends on how you brew it. Brewed well, it's really different.
lines.roman: maseun naerigi nareumimnida. jal naerimyeon jeongmal dallayo.

lines.beaver: 커피는 제 기호품이라 자주 사요. 할인 안 돼요?
lines.beaver_en: Coffee is my favorite treat, so I buy it often. No discount?
lines.beaver_roman: keopineun je gihopumira jaju sayo. harin an dwaeyo?
lines.learner: 이건 저희 점포 주력 상품이라 할인이 어렵습니다.
lines.en: This is our store's flagship product, so a discount is difficult.
lines.roman: igeon jeohui jeompo juryeok sangpumira harini eoryeopseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: The shop next door sells it cheaper, though.
lines.learner: 그 가게는 생필품 위주라 같은 원두는 아닐 거예요.
lines.en: That store mostly sells daily goods, so it is probably not the same beans.
lines.roman: geu gageneun saengpilpum wijura gateun wonduneun anil geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 두 봉지 사면 뭐 좀 주실 수 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: If I buy two bags, can you give me something?
lines.beaver_roman: du bongji samyeon mwo jom jusil su isseoyo?
lines.en: Then I'll give you a mug as a bonus.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Is it the cup on display over there?
lines.learner: 네, 저기 진열해 둔 파란 컵입니다.
lines.en: Yes, it's the blue cup we put on display there.
lines.roman: ne, jeogi jinyeolhae dun paran keobimnida.

lines.beaver_en: It's pretty. Then two bags, please.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 원두는 보관하기 나름이니 꼭 밀봉하세요.
lines.en: Thank you. Beans depend on how you store them, so seal them tight.
lines.roman: gamsahamnida. wonduneun bogwanhagi nareumini kkok milbonghaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Got it. I'll come back when I finish them.
lines.learner: 좋은 원두는 값어치를 하죠. 또 오세요!
lines.en: Good beans are worth the price. Come again!
lines.roman: joeun wonduneun gabeochireul hajyo. tto oseyo!
